ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 34

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 13

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

6. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 36
   D. 6

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 90

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

13. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 4

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

16. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

18. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

20. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

22. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
